R5B-bear-drive-0004.name: 2.7 km S of Long Lake
R5B-bear-drive-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R5B-bear-drive-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2006 (20 years old), 180 m SE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
S facing slope, 27 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 60 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; Bow Only; no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6)

plan: Drive: from Stuie, about 189 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.2141, -127.0554, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 290 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 116 m, about 17 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-14, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
